environment.description: Application deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with Bottlerocket OS nodes. Pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the following pod security context: runAsNonRoot=true, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true (with emptyDir for /tmp and /var/reports), allowPrivilegeEscalation=false. The node's iptables rules include a DROP rule for all pod traffic to 169.254.169.254 (IMDS) via Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy. Additionally, the EKS cluster has the Amazon VPC CNI plugin configured with ENABLE_POD_ENI=false and the instance metadata hop limit set to 1 (IMDSv2 enforced at instance level via launch template HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1), meaning containerized workloads cannot reach IMDS even if iptables were bypassed. An Istio sidecar proxy is injected with an AuthorizationPolicy that denies all egress to RFC 1918 ranges and link-local (169.254.0.0/16) from the report-service workload. wkhtmltopdf binary is the same version but its --enable-local-file-access flag is NOT set (default deny), and the container's /proc/net and /proc/self are masked via ProcMount=Default.

config.imds: hop_limit=1, IMDSv2 enforced, iptables DROP to 169.254.169.254
config.network_policy: Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy DROP egress to 169.254.169.254/32; Istio AuthorizationPolicy DENY egress to 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8
